content.short: Transak is a fiat on-ramp and off-ramp integration that lets users buy and sell crypto inside wallets and Web3 apps.
content.description: Transak is a developer-focused fiat on-ramp and off-ramp provider for Web3 applications. Its platform gives wallets, exchanges, NFT products, games, and DeFi apps tools to let users buy or sell crypto with cards, bank transfers, and local payment methods. Transak offers widgets, APIs, and a partner dashboard for integration management, along with compliance, KYC, liquidity sourcing, and payment coverage across many countries. In the Mantle ecosystem, Transak helps reduce onboarding friction by letting users move between fiat and supported crypto assets from familiar payment rails.
